levels.name: plan
levels.meaning: Reads and proposes. Changes no file and runs nothing that changes anything.

levels.name: ask
levels.meaning: May change files and run commands, each only after a person approves it.

levels.name: edits
levels.meaning: Changes files in its working tree without asking, and asks before anything else.

levels.name: bypass
levels.meaning: Acts without asking anyone: every approval prompt is skipped.
